name: BeatStitch
purpose: Original application code, build scripts, tests, and documentation. Free access with optional Ko-fi support. Third-party components and assets retain their own terms; experimental model packs require separate release review.

name: Python
credit: Python Software Foundation and Python contributors
license: PSF License Agreement and included third-party notices

name: Qt / Qt for Python
credit: The Qt Company and Qt Project contributors
purpose: Native interface, vector rendering, accessibility, and audio playback. Python bindings are provided by PySide6 and Shiboken. Individual Qt components include additional third-party notices. Original notices are retained from the matching Qt source distributions; some source components are omitted from this runtime.

name: Qt Cocoa accessibility repair
purpose: The macOS edition uses a locally built Qt 6.11.2 Cocoa plugin with the reviewed accessibility ownership fix. Source, patch, and rebuild instructions accompany the app. This is not an official Qt patch release.
license: Qt LGPL/GPL terms and accompanying component notices

name: FFmpeg / ffprobe
purpose: Audio decoding, probing, conversion, filtering, and export. The linked codec and support libraries are credited separately for this build.
license: Build-dependent LGPL/GPL terms; see this build's native-library entry and notices

name: FFmpeg in Qt Multimedia
credit: FFmpeg developers and Qt Multimedia contributors
purpose: The FFmpeg libraries supplied with Qt decode audio for native playback. These are separate from the command-line FFmpeg and ffprobe tools used for processing and export.
license: LGPL-2.1-or-later in the installed Qt Multimedia build; see Qt's third-party notices

name: Rubber Band
credit: Breakfast Quay, Chris Cannam, and Rubber Band contributors
purpose: Independent tempo changes and pitch transposition, including formant preservation.
license: GPL-2.0-or-later for the bundled open-source edition; see distribution notices

name: Barlow
purpose: Interface typeface: Regular, Medium, SemiBold, and Bold. The logo wordmark is outlined artwork.

name: OpenKeyScan
purpose: Source-key detection using the pinned OpenKeyScan 3 checkpoint and network code. Based on MusicalKeyCNN and key-classification research by Filip Korzeniowski and Gerhard Widmer. Original source license is preserved; the app adapts inference and preprocessing.

name: Beat This!
credit: Institute of Computational Perception, JKU Linz, Austria / CPJKU — copyright 2024
purpose: Beat and downbeat observations using the final0 model. Estimates support alignment, timing analysis, and tempo stabilization.

name: PANNs CNN10
credit: Qiuqiang Kong, Yin Cao, Turab Iqbal, Yuxuan Wang, Wenwu Wang, and Mark D. Plumbley
purpose: Passage observations for voices, instruments, and percussion. Adapted inference uses an equivalent FFT frontend; weights are unchanged apart from their local filename. See the attribution notice for the paper, revision, and modifications.
license: Weights: CC BY 4.0; inference code: MIT

name: EDMFormer / EDM-98
purpose: Experimental intro, build, drop, and breakdown analysis. Vendored inference source and local checkpoint are pinned; remote loading is replaced by verified local assets.

name: MusicFM
credit: Minz Won and collaborators; ByteDance Inc. — copyright 2023
purpose: Music representations used by optional section analysis. The flash-attention implementation is omitted. The exact MSD checkpoint matches the author's MIT-labeled model repository. The author does not confirm all third-party rights for a particular commercial use; the model label does not clear the underlying training recordings.
license: Included code: MIT; weights: publisher MIT model label; third-party commercial rights not confirmed

name: MuQ
credit: Tencent AI Lab and MuQ contributors
purpose: Music representations for optional section analysis. The inference subset omits MuLan, training, and flash attention, and loads verified local weights. The separate CC BY-NC model license permits noncommercial redistribution and use; it does not permit commercial model use. This restriction applies to the weights, not BeatStitch’s GPL code.

name: Spleeter
credit: Romain Hennequin, Anis Khlif, Felix Voituret, Manuel Moussallam; Deezer SA
purpose: Local vocal, drum, bass and accompaniment separation. The official four-stem weights are converted numerically to the existing PyTorch runtime. Architecture, padding and waveform synthesis were checked against upstream TensorFlow inference; separation quality is still recording-dependent.

name: GNU GCC runtimes (Mac build)
credit: Free Software Foundation, Inc. and GCC contributors
purpose: libgfortran, libgcc and libquadmath support SciPy numerical analysis. Matching source, the Darwin patch and rebuild recipe accompany the Mac release. Packaging changes relocation paths and signatures, not compiled code.
license: libquadmath: LGPL-2.1-or-later; libgfortran/libgcc: GPL-3.0-or-later with GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1
